label: PF Backlog 579
title: Eventing SSOT (Go): subscriber registry + dispatcher (cursor, at-least-once, dedupe, retry->DLQ)
body:
## Problem / why
No persisted subscription registry and no cross-process dispatcher; delivery must be reliable.

## Goal / value
Persisted subscriber registry (single writer, store-registry entry) + a dispatcher that fans out with
at-least-once delivery, event_id dedupe, and retry to the DLQ.

## In scope
- Subscription store {id, types[], filter, transport, target, auth_ref, enabled} registered in store-registry.json.
- Dispatcher reading the stream via cursor; dedupe by event_id; retry/backoff -> core/dead_letter_queue.

## Out of scope
- Transport implementations (E5); alert policy (E6).

## Acceptance criteria
- A registered subscription receives matching events exactly-once-effective; failures retry then DLQ.
- Registry has one writer; no second event store.

## Verification / test plan
- Retry/DLQ test; dedupe test; concurrency test.
